user_input: Pending workorder list
knowledge_base_examples:
Example 1 - 
User: How many Preventive Work Orders are still pending?
Assistant: select COUNT(*) from ai.workordermasterdetails w where workorder_facility_code in (<facilitycode>) and workorder_status not in ('Closed','Completed','Cancelled') and workorder_type = 'Preventive'

Example 2 - 
User: How many pending RCA-mandatory work orders?
Assistant: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai.workordermasterdetails
WHERE workorder_has_rca_mandatory = 't' and workorder_is_rca_completed ='f'
AND workorder_facility_code in (<facilitycode>);

Example 3 - 
User: How many PM work orders have been pending for approval?
Assistant: SELECT count(*)
FROM ai.workordermasterdetails 
where workorder_is_createdfrom ilike 'sm' 
and coalesce(workorder_pm_approvalstatus,'')!=''
and workorder_pm_approvalstatus not in ('Approved', 'Rejected') 
and workorder_facility_code IN (<facilitycode>);

Example 4 - 
User: How do I find work orders that have been reopened after completion
Assistant: SELECT workorder_id, workorder_status
FROM ai.workordermasterdetails
WHERE workorder_status in ('Reopened')
AND workorder_facility_code in (<facilitycode>);

Example 5 - 
User: What are all the RCA corrective actions generated work orders that have not yet been closed
Assistant: SELECT w.workorder_id,ca.workorder_rca_corrective_action_activity_description,workorder_rca_corrective_action_responsibility,workorder_rca_corrective_action_sustenanceplan,workorder_rca_corrective_action_targetdate,workorder_rca_corrective_action_generated_workorder_id,w.workorder_status
FROM ai.workorder_rca_corrective_action ca
Join ai.workordermasterdetails w
ON ca.workorder_rca_corrective_action_reference_workorder_id = w.workorder_id
WHERE w.workorder_status not in ('Closed','Completed','Cancelled')
AND w.workorder_facility_code in (<facilitycode>);

Example 6 - 
User: Which vendors are linked to work order WO022345 that have no expiry date set
Assistant: SELECT workorder_id,workorder_vendor_name,workorder_vendor_expiry_date
FROM ai.workorder_vendor
JOin ai.workordermasterdetails
ON workorder_vendor.workorder_vendor_workorder_id = workordermasterdetails.workorder_id
WHERE workorder_vendor.workorder_vendor_workorder_id = 'WO022345'
AND workorder_vendor_expiry_date IS NULL
AND workordermasterdetails.workorder_facility_code in (<facilitycode>);

Example 7 - 
User: What is the checklist available in the work order ID WO099995
Assistant: SELECT wc.workorder_checklist_taskdescription,wc.workorder_checklist_assignedto,wc.workorder_checklist_actualeffort,wc.workorder_checklist_plannedeffort,wc.workorder_checklist_mandatory,wc.workorder_checklist_taskpriority,wc.workorder_checklist_observation,wc.workorder_checklist_notes,wc.workorder_checklist_completionstatus FROM ai.workorder_checklist wc
JOin ai.workordermasterdetails wmd ON wc.workorder_checklist_workorder_id = wmd.workorder_id
WHERE wc.workorder_checklist_workorder_id = 'WO099995'
AND wmd.workorder_facility_code in (<facilitycode>);

Example 8 - 
User: What is the status of 'CHINP-WO0395658' WorkOrder?
Assistant: SELECT workorder_status FROM ai.workordermasterdetails WHERE workorder_id = 'CHINP-WO0395658' AND workorder_facility_code in (<facilitycode>);

Example 9 - 
User: How many work orders are currently in progress
Assistant: SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM ai.workordermasterdetails
WHERE workorder_status not in ('Closed','Completed','Cancelled')
AND workorder_facility_code in (<facilitycode>);

Example 10 - 
User: Which work orders have been assigned to 'Ideeswaran'
Assistant: SELECT workorder_assignee_workorder_id FROM ai.workorder_assignee WHERE workorder_assignee_name ilike '%Ideeswaran%' AND workorder_assignee_workorder_id in (SELECT workorder_id FROM ai.workordermasterdetails WHERE workorder_facility_code in (<facilitycode>);

knowledge_base_examples:
Example 1 - 
User: What are all the RCA corrective actions generated work orders that have not yet been closed
Assistant: SELECT w.workorder_id,ca.workorder_rca_corrective_action_activity_description,workorder_rca_corrective_action_responsibility,workorder_rca_corrective_action_sustenanceplan,workorder_rca_corrective_action_targetdate,workorder_rca_corrective_action_generated_workorder_id,w.workorder_status
FROM ai.workorder_rca_corrective_action ca
Join ai.workordermasterdetails w
ON ca.workorder_rca_corrective_action_reference_workorder_id = w.workorder_id
WHERE w.workorder_status not in ('Closed','Completed','Cancelled')
AND w.workorder_facility_code in (<facilitycode>);

User: Can I see a list of all available spare parts along with their quantities
Assistant: SELECT s.spareparts_store_wise_stock_part_code,s.spareparts_store_wise_stock_store_code, s.spareparts_store_wise_stock_available_quantity
FROM ai.spareparts_store_wise_stock s
JOIN ai.facilitylinkstore f ON s.spareparts_store_wise_stock_store_code = f.facilitylink_storecode
WHERE s.spareparts_store_wise_stock_store_code IN ('1106-ENG4')
AND f.facilitylink_facility_code IN (<facilitycode>);

ON spareparts_store_wise_stock.spareparts_store_wise_stock_store_code = ai.facilitylinkstore.facilitylink_storecode
WHERE spareparts_store_wise_stock.spareparts_store_wise_stock_store_code IN ('1106-ENG4') AND spareparts_master.spareparts_part_activestatus = TRUE AND ai.facilitylinkstore.facilitylink_facility_code IN (<facilitycode>);

JOIN ai.spareparts_store_wise_stock sws

AND sws.spareparts_store_wise_stock_store_code IN ('1106-ENG4')
AND fls.facilitylink_facility_code IN (<facilitycode>);

WHERE spareparts_store_wise_stock_store_code in (<facilitycode>) and workorder_spareparts_createdtime >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month';

JOIN ai.facilitylinkstore
ON spareparts_store_wise_stock_store_code = ai.facilitylinkstore.facilitylink_storecode

Assistant: SELECT im.instrument_code,
cmd.calibration_id,
cmd.calibration_date,
cmd.calibration_facility_code,cmd.calibration_category, cmd.calibration_status
FROM ai.instrument_master im
JOin ai.calibrationmasterdetails cmd
ON im.instrument_code = cmd.calibration_instrument_code
WHERE cmd.calibration_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
AND cmd.calibration_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
AND cmd.calibration_facility_code in(<facilitycode>)
ORDER BY cmd.calibration_date;

Example 2 - 
User: Can you identify instruments that have been installed before 2022 and pending for calibration
Assistant: SELECT im.instrument_code,
im.instrument_installation_date,
cmd.calibration_id,
cmd.calibration_status,
cmd.calibration_facility_code,cmd.calibration_category, cmd.calibration_status
FROM ai.instrument_master im
LEFT JOin ai.calibrationmasterdetails cmd
ON im.instrument_code = cmd.calibration_instrument_code
WHERE im.instrument_installation_date < '2023-01-01'
and cmd.calibration_status not in ('Closed','Completed','Cancelled')
AND cmd.calibration_facility_code in (<facilitycode>) ORDER BY im.instrument_installation_date;

User: Identify instruments where calibration validity has expired
Assistant: SELECT 
c.calibration_id, 
c.calibration_instrument_code, 
i.instrument_master_information_validity
FROM 
ai.calibrationmasterdetails c
LEFT JOIN LATERAL 
unnest(c.calibration_master_instrument_information_id) AS inst_id 
ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN 
ai.instrument_master_information i 
ON inst_id = i.instrument_master_information_id
WHERE 
i.instrument_master_information_validity < CURRENT_DATE
AND c.calibration_facility_code IN (<facilitycode>);
